name: prisdvl-github-profile-crt
description: Local CRT-style GitHub profile assets for Prisdvl (svg-terminal + postprocess + activity SVGs)

scripts.generate:terminal: npm run inject:ascii && npm exec --yes -- svg-terminal generate --config terminal.yml --output assets/terminal.svg
scripts.generate:terminal:static: npm exec --yes -- svg-terminal generate --config terminal.yml --output assets/terminal-static.svg --static
scripts.compose:split: node scripts/compose-split-terminal.mjs assets/terminal.svg && node scripts/compose-split-terminal.mjs assets/terminal-static.svg --static
scripts.build:crt: npm run generate:terminal && npm run generate:terminal:static && npm run compose:split && npm run postprocess:anim && npm run postprocess:static
scripts.build:profile: npm run generate:ascii && npm run generate:contribution
scripts.build:all: npm run build:crt && npm run build:profile
